c74object.name: tap.python~
c74object.digest: Process audio with a Python class
c74object.description: Process audio with a Python class. The argument names a file in the package's python folder, which must define a class of the same name. The class's type-annotated public fields become attributes (int, float, bool and str; Optional allowed), and its public methods become messages called according to their signatures, with methods named int, float, symbol and bang answering those standard messages. Its process() method runs on the signal: once per signal vector when annotated with numpy arrays, or once per sample when annotated with float. An optional prepare(sample_rate, vector_size) method receives the audio settings before audio starts and whenever they change. The file is watched and reloaded when saved, keeping attribute values; errors are printed to the Max console and never take Max down.

objarg.name: source
objarg.description: Python class file. The name of a .py file in the package's python folder, without the extension, which must define a class of the same name; it must be a valid Python identifier. Without an argument, python/default.py is loaded.

method.name: filechanged
method.description: Reload the Python file. The object's file watcher sends it when the file is saved; send it yourself to force a reload.
